moving_protocol.train: Existing training layouts only; whole episodes
moving_protocol.validation: Two existing validation layout families per size with newly declared motion
regimes: High cup / empty bottle tilting and withdrawing
moving_protocol.reserved: 18 fresh low/high moving fixtures, declared before fitting on new images; old nine tests never reused for selection

autonomy_gates: All-size primary and independent color train/validation accuracy
scope: Known dimensions, original bottle and material A. Authored calibration is never autonomous grasp evidence. No old reserved images enter fitting.
low_fill_rationale: Independent color fits fail low-fill generalization. Add 18 measured cut-0.29 training scenes at two existing training layouts per size; no validation/test identity changes.
motion_definition: Start upright beside cup, smoothly tilt to 65 degrees with colored source or 82 degrees empty, then return; transverse sinusoidal translation. Authored fixture only. Travel is maximum pairwise observed displacement.

moving_frame_evaluation.label: Native same-timestamp cup surface height; all moving frames scored, not just settled final frames
